newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippines says November exports grow 29.8 pct.
newsitem.headline: Philippines says November exports grow 29.8 pct.

text.p: Philippine exports rose 29.8 percent in November last year against the year-ago period, the National Statistics Office (NSO) said.
The NSO said export receipts in November totalled $1.846 billion against the November 1995 level of $1.423 billion.
The NSO has previously said exports in the first 11 months of the year reached $18.656 billion against $15.826 billion in the year-ago period.
It said the rise in November export was the largest year-on-year growth recorded for any month in the year.
The NSO said the growth was led by the electronics and components sector, which recorded an increase of 57 percent in export receipts, and apparel and clothing, which grew 8.1 percent.
The NSO said the United States, the country's top market, accounted for 30.5 percent of November exports, followed by Japan and Singapore.
